messages:
jess_fin: Heads up - Arcadia Analytics sent INV-48923 for $12,450. AP auto-flagged: no PO on invoice. Vendor says this covers two SOWs plus shipping consolidated. Need routing guidance.

mike_proc: Can you attach the PDF and vendor remittance? If it's two SOWs we may need to split across two POs or do a Non-PO approval.

jess_fin: attached invoice + vendor email. They referenced contract C-2024-Arcadia, not a PO. Vendor asks that shipping be split across PO-789 and PO-790.

sara_fpna: AP matching output: `MATCH_FAIL: candidates [PO-789, PO-790]; ambiguous allocation; freight unmapped`. Three-way match failed.

rohit_eng: Work was under two change orders (SOW-A, SOW-B). Procurement only issued one PO due to backlog; vendor used contract ref instead of PO.

amanda_ops: Options: ask vendor to reissue with explicit PO refs (preferred) or move to Non-PO Review for manual receipt verification and finance approval. Which is faster for Friday payrun?

mike_proc: Ask vendor to reissue but assume slow. For timing, move to Non-PO Review and open a procurement request to issue missing PO. Route GL approval to @sara_fpna.

procure-bot: Ticket PR-4521 created: "Arcadia INV-48923 - missing PO / split freight" assigned to procurement-queue.

ap-system: Invoice INV-48923 moved to Non-PO Review. Hold timer 72h. Attach receipts/acceptance to PR-4521.

sara_fpna: Proposed GL split: SOW-A -> GL 5601 (product research); SOW-B -> GL 5602 (infrastructure). Split freight pro-rata by line totals. Approver: sara_fpna.

jess_fin: I'll ask vendor to reissue and include PR-4521 link. If they cannot, proceed with manual split and payment hold. :thumbsup:

mike_proc: Following up with procurement to issue missing PO; will update PR-4521 when complete.

rohit_eng: Added acceptance email (deliverables accepted 2024-11-02) to PR-4521 to speed approval.

amanda_ops: Flagged for Friday payrun. If no vendor reissue by EOD Thursday we proceed with manual route per Sara's allocations.

jess_fin: Closing loop when PR-4521 contains PO or payment record.
